cookie.label: Login Cookie
cookie.description: Optional. A login cookie grabbed from an existing browser session, only needed to play age restricted or otherwise private videos.

po_token_server_url.label: PO Token Server URL
po_token_server_url.description: Optional. URL to a BgUtil PO Token server (e.g. `http://127.0.0.1:4416`). Only needed when YouTube starts refusing anonymous playback.

manifest.description: Search and play the audio of plain YouTube videos.
